subject: Re: Dissertation proposal timeline
body:
Hi {{firstName}},
Thanks for sending over the revised outline. I read through it last night and I think the framing of the second research question is much stronger now.
Let's aim to have the full proposal draft to the committee by the first week of December so everyone has time to review before the holidays. A few things on my end before then:
  • I'll email Dr. Canavan to confirm he can serve on the committee.
  • Can you tighten the related-work section to around 8 pages? Right now it runs a little long.
  • Let's meet next Tuesday at 2pm in ENB 314 to go over the methodology.
Does Tuesday work for you? If not, send me a couple of times that do and I'll adjust.
Best,
Tempestt
Tempestt Neal, Ph.D.
Associate Professor, Bellini College of Computing, Cybersecurity, and AI
University of South Florida
